# vibecodedshit.com

> A free, open benchmark for codebase health. Health is how safely and cheaply someone with no memory of a codebase, whether a contractor or an AI agent, can make a correct change. The score has six dimensions, 30 parameters and four bands: Vibe-coded (0-39), Fragile (40-59), Stable (60-79) and Agent-ready (80-100).

## Docs

- [Methodology v1.0](https://vibecodedshit.com/methodology/): how the score is computed. Six dimensions, 30 parameters, fixed rubrics. CC BY 4.0.
- [FAQ](https://vibecodedshit.com/faq/): what it is, how to get a score, what is sent, licences.
- [Emergency Save terms](https://vibecodedshit.com/terms/): the $100 emergency call and the one-day Emergency Save.

## Get a score

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Raavn/vibecodedshit.com): the methodology and the scoring engine (Elastic License 2.0).
- Add the plugin to Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add Raavn/vibecodedshit.com`
- Install it: `/plugin install codebase-health@vibecodedshit`
- Run it: `/codebase-health`
- Add the plugin to Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add Raavn/vibecodedshit.com`, then install codebase-health from the Plugins Directory
- Run it in Codex: `$codebase-health`
